summary: PR 1413 at 678b659 is test-only hardening. Its production-created buffer fixture is better than the prior hand-sized fixture, but all seven loader/shape cases already pass on the recorded base, so it supplies no failing-before reproduction or production correction for the original Hidden size mismatch. The only base failure fixed by the candidate is ROCm leakage into a mocked NVIDIA backend-selection test, which is unrelated to the reported H800 checkpoint-load assertion.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression: 8 passed plus 3 subtests; checkout-local SGLang production sources were imported.
Independent failing-before check: all 7 candidate loader/model-contract cases already pass on the recorded base, demonstrating no regression catches the original failure.
The base test fails because the physical ROCm platform leaks into a mocked SM100 case; this is test isolation, not the original SM90 Hidden size mismatch.
The SM90 preprocessing/kernel suite was attempted and skipped on the AMD host.

gpu_evidence: No issue-specific GPU execution was possible. The assigned device is AMD Instinct MI355X (ROCm 7.2), while the reported path requires NVIDIA SM90/H800 and FlashInfer CUDA kernels.
remaining_counterexamples: No full DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 checkpoint load reproduces or clears the original Hidden size mismatch.
No FlashInfer SM90 post-load preprocessing or kernel execution validates the loaded/permuted expert dimensions.
The candidate's 1024/64 and 2048/127 boundary test only compares tensor shapes; it does not execute the loader and assert rejection.
The candidate loader regression passes unchanged on the recorded base, so it cannot distinguish the allegedly broken implementation from the candidate.
No four-rank H800 TP=4, DSPARK, HTTP serving, or semantic-output validation was performed.
remaining_limitations: The assigned GPU is AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 on ROCm 7.2, not NVIDIA SM90/H800.
The candidate changes no production or native source, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The prepared checkout imports SGLang from /job/repo/python; Torch comes from /opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages and reports 2.11.0+rocm7.2.
